user.title: Add a Speldosa box
user.description: Pick the box and the speaker it plays on. The box shows up under ESPHome once it is added. Tags are linked on the Speldosa page in the sidebar.

error.not_a_box: This device has no Tag sensor. Is it a Speldosa box with current firmware?
error.not_ma_player: Pick a speaker that comes from Music Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This box is already set up.
abort.no_music_assistant: Music Assistant is not set up in Home Assistant. Add it first, then add the box.

init.title: Box settings
init.description: Tags are linked on the Speldosa page in the sidebar.

data_description.resume_window_min: A tag put back within this time continues where it stopped, whatever its play mode.
data_description.start_volume: Volume when a new album, song or story starts. 0 leaves the volume as it is.
data_description.solo: Takes the speaker out of a speaker group first, so the box plays only in its own room.
data_description.music_account: With two accounts of a music service in Music Assistant (for example two Spotify family members), pick the one this box plays through, so two boxes can play at the same time. Tags stay shared: any tag plays on any box.

error.not_ma_player: Pick a speaker that comes from Music Assistant.

unknown_tag.message: Tag {tag} was put on **{box}** and has no music yet. Open Speldosa in the sidebar to link it, and leave the tag on the box while you do.
